why: the validation harness, asked about an animal it holds no parameters for

result.error: organism "flying-mouse-gen0" has a taxon base (Mus musculus) with no reference parameter set and no declared one, so STATE cannot be resolved: there is no body-plan parameter to age-scale and no ontogeny track to scale it by. The taxon still reaches the law check, which decides clade scope from it. Two ways forward: add a reference parameter set for this taxon to the engine's bundle, or DECLARE the quantities this design needs -- organism_create/organism_from_blueprint take `declared: { parameters: { mass_kg: { value, source }, ... }, life_stages: [...] }`, each value with a source, and they enter STATE as kind "assumed" so nothing downstream can mistake them for measurements.
